functional.reason: Functional results were not produced with the skill evaluation tool: each eval needs a live ElastiCache fault (memory filled under noeviction, KEYS/HGETALL load, a hot key, connection churn) running while the agent investigates, and the tool provisions agent spaces but not the faulted resources. Instead the author ran the same comparison manually in two DevOps Agent spaces (with and without the skill) against injected faults on a test cluster: 4 scenarios, 40 investigations, scored per run. Results, scoring rubric and one full response per side for each scenario are in evals/manual-functional-results.md. Structure and best-practices results in this directory were produced with the tool (both 100%). The skill was restructured for best practices after the manual runs (diagnosis table moved to references/diagnosis-table.md, checklist workflow, validation step, new description); the guidance itself is unchanged. After the manual runs, rows were added to the diagnosis table for client-side causes found in earlier base-agent testing (client timeout below normal latency, retry bursts without backoff, network limits, climbing connections, IAM token expiry, in-transit encryption mismatch); those rows were not part of the 40 investigations.
